subject: Final nudge: flexible trial top-up + runway extension request
messages:
From: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@stratalabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short pilot top-up & runway extension

Hi Markus,

Quick note — we pushed the Strata MVP into a small internal pilot last week and token consumption spiked sooner than we expected. We love the latency and the quality so far, but our trial bucket is going to hit 0 in ~4 days. Two asks:

- Can Redwood extend the trial window by 30 days?
- Can we get a small top-up (tokens/credits) to finish the pilot and finalize the evaluation?

If we can get one or both, I can commit to a production evaluation with a technical proof-of-value in April. Happy to hop on a quick call today if that helps.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Moreno
Head of Integrations, Strata Labs
alyssa@stratalabs.com
(415) 555-0142

P.S. attaching a short usage export from last 3 days so you can see the spike. (attached: Strata_MVP_usage.csv)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@stratalabs.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short pilot top-up & runway extension

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and the CSV, that helps. Great to hear the pilot is doing well.

We can definitely do a 30-day runway extension immediately. For the top-up, I can propose a targeted pilot credit (150K tokens equivalent, ~USD 3k value) contingent on a quick product-readiness checklist and an agreement that if you move to paid in 60 days the credit converts against the first invoice.

I need internal signoff for that conversion clause and the $3k equivalent, so I’ll loop in Sales Ops and my manager for a quick approval. If you prefer, I can also offer a straight 30-day extended trial without conversion terms. Which do you prefer?

If conversion is OK, please confirm and I’ll expedite approvals and send a brief SOW + DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Subject: FWD: Request: short pilot top-up & runway extension — quick approval needed

Team — forwarding a request from Strata Labs (Alyssa Moreno). Usage jumped unexpectedly; they’re asking for a 30-day extension + a small top-up to finish the pilot. I attached their usage export. Key context:

- Account: Strata Labs (early-stage infra analytics)
- ARR potential: $60–90k first year if pilot converts
- Current pilot traction: internal POC, positive latency/quality feedback
- Requested top-up: approx USD 3k equivalent (150K tokens)
- Desired terms: top-up converts to invoice credit if they sign a paid plan within 60 days

Ask: can we approve a conditional top-up (150K tokens / ~$3k) with the conversion clause? If not, what lower amount is acceptable? If approved, I’ll send a compact SOW and DocuSign.

Attachments: Strata_MVP_usage.csv

Thanks — Markus

—
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: FWD: Request: short pilot top-up & runway extension — quick approval needed

Markus / Laura,

This looks reasonable for an EoQ conversion push. Approve conditional 150K-token top-up with the following guardrails:

- Credit applies only to pilot usage and expires 30 days after issuance.
- Conversion clause: if Strata converts to a paid plan (>= $3k/mo committed) within 60 days, credit is applied against first invoice.
- Require SOW (one-pager) and PO or signed acceptance via DocuSign before issuing credits.
- Sales Ops to log credit in finance tagging with deal STRA-3412.

I’m attaching a short SOW template you can use (SOW-Strata-pilot-v1.2.pdf). Please also ask them to confirm the technical contacts so CS can standby.

Karthik
Head of Sales, West
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Hi Alyssa / Evan — good news. We signed off on a conditional pilot top-up. Summary of what we’ll do: 

- Issuing a 150,000-token credit (~USD 3,000 value) to Strata Labs. Credit expires in 30 days from issuance.
- 30-day trial runway extension applied immediately.
- Conversion clause: if Strata signs a paid plan >= $3k/mo within 60 days, the credit will be applied to the first invoice.
- Before issuance: please sign the attached one-page SOW and countersign via DocuSign (link below). We’ll only enable the credit after we receive the signed SOW/PO.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/STRA-3412-topup
Attachment: SOW-Strata-pilot-v1.2.pdf

Next steps for you:
1) Sign SOW and return via DocuSign.
2) Confirm technical contacts for CS handoff (name + email).
3) Let me know if you want the credits applied all at once or staged (we can split into two releases if you want checkpoints).

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through the SOW if helpful.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199
